name: Bhagavad Gita 6.5
text:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् ।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः ॥
meaning: Lift yourself through your own effort; do not bring yourself down. The self can be one’s own friend, and the self can also become one’s own obstacle.
purpose: A verse on self-responsibility and the cultivation of inner support.
supports: Self-talk; personal agency; recognising habits that help or hinder.
when: When building a routine or reflecting on choices.
